name: performance-pack
title: Performance Pack
author: bespoked
description:
Smoother, quieter, cooler motion and a purge line that is out of your way, in one install. Smoother Motion brings the printer's motion engine up to date with the newest Klipper code, for cleaner surfaces and less ghosting. TMC Auto-Tuned applies Argolein's optimized TMC2240 driver settings to the X and Y steppers, TMC Low Current drops their run current from 1.2 to 1.0 A for less heat and less noise, and Purge Line at Back moves the start-of-print purge line from the front of the plate to the back, clear of the part. The two driver plugins touch different settings, so they work together.

The driver changes are low level: watch the motor temperatures on the first print, and if you see a layer shift on a fast or heavy move, remove TMC Low Current and the stock current comes back. Snapmaker U1 only.
tagline: Smoother, quieter, cooler motion and a purge line out of your way.
